items.summary: NFL Network reported a high-ankle sprain from the September 9 opener. X-rays were negative; MRI results/timetable were still pending as of this check.
items.fantasy_significance: Material downgrade for SR and creates a temporary New England target opportunity.

sparta_ownership.reason: No current Yahoo/user ownership evidence in repository; absence from draft/current files is not free-agent proof.

items.summary: Hollins already held the second-largest Patriots WR role before Brown exited and finished Week 1 with four catches for a team-high 51 receiving yards. PFF's Week 1 recap also identified Hollins as playing more than Romeo Doubs.
items.fantasy_significance: Immediate Yahoo availability check during the Week 1 free-pickup window. This is not an acquisition recommendation until Sparta availability is confirmed.

sparta_ownership.reason: No current Yahoo/user ownership evidence in repository; absence from draft/current files is not free-agent proof.

items.summary: New England used Williams for additional X-receiver reps after Brown exited, but his Week 1 role was smaller than Hollins'.
items.fantasy_significance: Secondary availability check/watch only; Hollins is the first Patriots receiver to check.

items.summary: Doubs remains owned in Sparta and therefore is not an add candidate despite the Brown injury.
items.fantasy_significance: Do not recommend as an acquisition.

recommendation.why: Brown's injury plus Hollins' pre-existing snap role and Week 1 production create a short-term full-PPR opportunity.
recommendation.urgency: HIGH — check Yahoo before the Week 1 free-pickup window closes.
recommendation.confidence: MEDIUM on role opportunity; NONE on Sparta availability until Yahoo/user evidence confirms it.
recommendation.roster_comparison: If Yahoo confirms Hollins is available, compare him against the bottom WR-stash tier on JD (Devaughn Vele, Ja'Kobi Lane, and Dontayvion Wicks) before executing. No drop is authorized or recorded.

notification_reason: New injury-created opportunity warrants an immediate Sparta availability check, but no add/drop is recommended because Hollins and Williams remain UNKNOWN.
